# Meshes (final1.SLDASM, generated by tools/gen.py)

- `visual/*.stl` – visual meshes split by colour (`_grey` = PETG grey, `_orange` = PETG orange,
  `_dark` = servo/horn), expressed in each link's own frame. All six legs are geometrically
  identical (< 0.1 mm), so one coxa/femur/tibia/foot mesh set is shared by every leg.
- `collision/*.stl` – convex hulls of body, coxa, femur and tibia. The foot uses a sphere
  (radius 16.3 mm) in `urdf/leg.xacro`, not a mesh, for stable contact and a clean contact sensor.
- Surface deviation from the CAD after decimation: p99 <= 0.7 mm, max <= 0.85 mm
  (see `doc/verification_log.txt`).

File names and case are part of the `package://hexapod_description/meshes/...` URIs.
Regenerate with `tools/read_step.py` + `tools/gen.py` rather than editing by hand.
